DraftActorProof.ExactHeadwordClause: 乃至千七百沒巴鼻漢一味無私，心心相印，法法相傳。
DraftActorProof.SpeechFrame: 震聲，云：「大眾見壽昌放眉間白毫相光麼？」良久，復曰：「天無私覆，地無私載，日月無私明，時候無私序，帝王無私德，臣民無私功，善惡無私報。所以，靈山拈無私之花，少林面無私之壁，二祖安無私之心，曹溪傳無私之法，青原、南嶽開無私之二宗，馬祖、石頭列無私之五派。百丈撥無私之火，溈山直下知歸；黃檗揮無私之棒，臨濟頓徹婆心；雲巖示無私之鏡，洞山錦縫重開；雪峰陞無私之堂，雲門當機獨領；地藏豎無私之指，法眼妙契天然。乃至千七百沒巴鼻漢一味無私，心心相印，法法相傳。至我壽昌先師翁，觸發大好無私之山，重興曹洞之旨；洎我東苑先和上，勘破臺山無私之路，透過趙州之關；迄我道盛，偶入東父無私之室，勒回鞭影之駒，親承壽祖無私之宗，振起簫韶之鳳。是故，二十年來縱橫方外，無私任運，到處自強。今日歸家，幸逢法屬，推上法王無私之座，重揚先祖無私之風，何異削雪為銀火不銷，白戰未曾持寸銕？雖然如是，今日開堂一句作麼生道？」良久，云：「高提祖印當空照，一道無私謝太平。」結椎，下座。
DraftActorProof.FullCaseDecision: Source text (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄). Juelang Daosheng owns the exact headword-bearing turn in the complete case.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The expression denotes with no handle to grasp in these Chan records. Its wording is there is no nose-handle: no projecting part by which the thing can be seized or led.
EvidenceBody: Frozen-corpus concordance: 197 exact hits in 93 storage files representing 91 independent works. Chan records apply it to sayings, circumstances, people, and what a listener confronts. Dahui pairs it with 'no flavor' and says there is nothing to grasp when considering the dry shit-stick or the raised saying. Another record reverses the phrase into a place of inquiry: 'investigate until there is no handle; precisely where there is no handle is good to investigate.' Wuzhun plays the compound against the positive form, saying there is some handle and entirely no handle. This recurring use for the point at which a word or encounter supplies no graspable lead is the corpus-specific extension of the animal-handle image.
